bash -lc '
set -e
p="/src/mruby/mrbgems/mruby-bigint/core/bigint.c"
# Step 1: insert defensive buffer after zero(x);
awk \'{print} /zero\(x\);/ && !buffer_inserted { buffer_inserted=1; print "  char *buf = NULL;"; print "  const char *str = s;"; print "  size_t slen = (size_t)len;"; print "  buf = (char*)mrb_malloc(mrb, slen+1);"; print "  if (buf) {"; print "    for (size_t __i = 0; __i < slen; ++__i) buf[__i] = s[__i];"; print "    buf[slen] = '\\0';"; print "    str = buf;"; print "  }"; next} \' $p > /tmp/bigint.c.in && mv /tmp/bigint.c.in $p
# Step 2: replace all s[i] with str[i] in the function body
perl -0777 -pi -e 's/s\[i\]/str[i]/g' "$p"
# Step 3: free the buffer before return
perl -0777 -pe 's/mpz_clear\(mrb,&t\);\n\s*return retval;/mpz_clear(mrb,&t);\n  if (buf) mrb_free(mrb, buf);\n  return retval;/' -i "$p" 
'

bash -lc '
python - << "PY" 
import re,sys
p="/src/mruby/mrbgems/mruby-bigint/core/bigint.c"
with open(p, "r") as f:
    s = f.read()
anchor = "static int\nmpz_init_set_str(mrb_state *mrb, mpz_t *x, const char *s, mrb_int len, mrb_int base)"
pos = s.find(anchor)
if pos == -1:
    print("anchor not found")
    sys.exit(1)
brace = s.find("{", pos)
if brace == -1:
    print("brace not found")
    sys.exit(1)
start_body = brace + 1
# insert after zero(x); occurrence near there
idx = s.find("zero(x);", start_body)
if idx == -1:
    print("zero(x); not found")
    sys.exit(1)
idx_end = idx + len("zero(x);")
ins = (
"\n  char *buf = NULL;\n"
"  const char *str = s;\n"
"  size_t slen = (size_t)len;\n"
"  buf = (char*)mrb_malloc(mrb, slen + 1);\n"
"  if (buf) {\n"
"    for (size_t __i = 0; __i < slen; __i++) buf[__i] = s[__i];\n"
"    buf[slen] = '\\0';\n"
"    str = buf;\n"
"  }\n"
)
s2 = s[:idx_end] + ins + s[idx_end:]
s2 = s2.replace("s[i]", "str[i]")
s2 = s2.replace("mpz_clear(mrb,&t);\n  return retval;", "mpz_clear(mrb,&t);\n  if (buf) mrb_free(mrb, buf);\n  return retval;")
with open(p, 'w') as f:
    f.write(s2)
print("patched")
PY'
